action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
Marcus Brinkmann discovered that during decryption or verification, GnuPG
did not properly filter out terminal sequences when reporting the original
filename. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause an application
parsing GnuPG output to incorrectly interpret the status of the
cryptographic operation reported by GnuPG.
isummary:
GnuPG could be made to report incorrect verification results to other
applications.
